en:
Keebo? What's wrong? You're not gonna
head downstairs?

...Shuichi, I have a favor to ask of you. This
hammer disables electronic machines, right?

Are you concerned that it
will disable you too?

The outcome will settle once and for all how
Miu perceived me.

I...don't think it's a good idea to test that.
Remember the hydraulic press?

Besides, it's supposed to use a lot
of energy, we shouldn't waste it.

I see, it would be waste.
Yes, we shouldn't be wasteful.
